<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.61.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [chore] Remove deprecated `use_column_width` parameter from `st.image` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15786
* [fix] Deprecate string file paths in st.html/st.iframe in favour of pathlib.Path by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16150
### New Features 🎉
* [feat] Add lazy loading for st.dataframe by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15756
* [feature] Add `icon` parameter to `st.metric` (#12298) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15805
* [feature] Add background refresh for st.cache_data and st.cache_resource by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16057
* [feature] Add WebSocket Host allow-list by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16147
* Add seconds granularity and `format` for hour cycle to `st.time_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16126
* Improve form support and enter to submit to `st.time_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16128
* Infer download_button file_name and mime from file object name by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16061
* [feature] Enforce disabled widget parameter server-side by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16209
* Improve tag accessibility in `st.multiselect` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16200
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Popover in sidebar rendered off-screen by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16087
* [fix] Escape now clears typed search query in st.selectbox by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16088
* Fix AppTest sys.path handling for script paths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15775
* [fix] Clear stale AppTest elements on rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16123
* [fix] Clarify AppTest multipage path handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16122
* Fix st.selectbox fuzzy search only matches contiguous substrings since 1.59.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16009
* [fix] Commit open data_editor cell edit on outside click by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16132
* [fix] TypeError in run_every fragments with Sentry threading by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16140
* [fix] Prevent st.data_editor row additions overwriting rows by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16144
* [fix] Reject network paths and null bytes in st.Page by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16146
* [fix] st.expander clipped after interrupted animation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16090
* [fix] Lock Mermaid init config overrides by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16151
* [bugfix] Honor Plotly layout fonts in Sankey charts (#11031) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16164
* [bugfix] Multiselect dropdown background matches sidebar theme (#11348) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16163
* fix(selectbox): flip sidebar dropdown up instead of clipping by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16199
* [bugfix] Preserve IME composition in data_editor NumberColumn (#16129) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16165
* [fix] Right-side padding preserved when code block is scrolled by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16091
* [bugfix] Higher-DPI Altair PNG export (#8177) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16170
* [fix] st.bar_chart fails on column names containing "." by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16089
* [fix] Stable dataframe header background with alpha (#11950) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16166
* [fix] Preserve fragment children across container reruns (#12514) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16171
* [fix] Reconnect to existing session on unclean websocket close by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15909
* [fix] Accept io.StringIO data in st.download_button by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16272
* [fix] Keep pills and segmented_control selection highlighted when format_func changes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16271
* [fix] Suppress the skills nudge when an install would only conflict, and report why by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15966
* Fix st.help header showing "page.run()" in multipage apps by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16244
### Other Changes
* [chore] Release v1.60.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16110
* Remove `Baseweb` from `TimeInput` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15647
* Support pasting values in `TimeInput` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16096
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16202
* [chore] Adopt uv.lock for deterministic Python environments by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15968
* [chore] Replace gitpython with subprocess git calls by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16241
* [feature] Turn `st.Page` into a proper class by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16268

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15775
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16009
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16061

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.60.0...1.61.0
